acceptance/test_allocate_freight.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.allocate_freight import allocate_freight


def test_proportional():
    assert allocate_freight(1000, [3000, 1000]) == [750, 250]
    assert allocate_freight(100, [1, 1, 1]) == [34, 33, 33]
    assert allocate_freight(0, [0, 0]) == [0, 0]


def test_remainder_ties():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [0, 2]
    assert allocate_freight(5, [1, 3, 6]) == [0, 2, 3]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(-5, [10])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        allocate_freight(10, [0, 0])


def test_regression_issue_520():
    assert allocate_freight(2, [100, 300]) == [1, 1]

acceptance/test_average_daily_demand.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.average_daily_demand import average_daily_demand

LINES = [
    "1;SHP;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;7 EA",
    "2;SHP;ABC-123456-1;A-01-01-1;1 CS",
    "2;RCV;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;5 CS",
    "# day 3",
    "3;RTN;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;4 EA",
    "5;SHP;KIT-200001-3;A-01-01-1;9 EA",
    "8;SHP;ABC-123456-1;B-07-14-3;2 EA",
]
SIZES = {"ABC-123456-1": 6}


def test_window():
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "KIT-200001-3", 1, 10) == 1
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 4, 8) == 1
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "TEE-104520-4", 1, 30) == 0


def test_returns():
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 1, 4) == 3
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 3, 3) == 0


def test_bad_range():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 5, 4)


def test_regression_issue_275():
    assert average_daily_demand(LINES, SIZES, "ABC-123456-1", 1, 4) == 4

acceptance/test_first_fit_decreasing.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.first_fit_decreasing import first_fit_decreasing


def test_packing():
    items = [("a", 4), ("b", 7), ("c", 3), ("d", 6)]
    assert first_fit_decreasing(items, 10) == [[("b", 7), ("c", 3)], [("d", 6), ("a", 4)]]
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("x", 10)], 10) == [[("x", 10)]]


def test_equal_weights():
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("p3", 5), ("p1", 5), ("p2", 5)], 10) == [[("p1", 5), ("p2", 5)], [("p3", 5)]]
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("k", 2), ("j", 2), ("big", 8)], 10) == [[("big", 8), ("j", 2)], [("k", 2)]]


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        first_fit_decreasing([("a", 1)], 0)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        first_fit_decreasing([("a", -1)], 10)


def test_regression_issue_266():
    assert first_fit_decreasing([("k", 2), ("j", 2), ("big", 8)], 10) == [[("big", 8), ("k", 2)], [("j", 2)]]

from stockflow.round_to_pack import round_to_pack

    assert round_to_pack(24, 12) == 24
    assert round_to_pack(0, 12) == 12
    assert round_to_pack(5, 10, min_packs=3) == 30


def test_rounding():
    assert round_to_pack(13, 12) == 12
    assert round_to_pack(18, 12) == 24
    assert round_to_pack(29, 12) == 24


def test_invalid():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_to_pack(-1, 12)


def test_regression_issue_142():
    assert round_to_pack(13, 12) == 24

acceptance/test_safety_stock.py.initial:
import pytest

from stockflow.safety_stock import safety_stock


def test_whole_numbers():
    assert safety_stock([10, 20, 30], [4, 6]) == 80
    assert safety_stock([5, 5, 5], [2, 2]) == 0
    assert safety_stock([7, 8, 9], [5]) == 5


def test_fractional_result():
    assert safety_stock([10, 15], [3, 4]) == 17
    assert safety_stock([1, 2], [1, 2]) == 2


def test_errors():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        safety_stock([4, 6], [])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        safety_stock([4, 6], [2, -1])


def test_regression_issue_163():
    assert safety_stock([10, 15], [3, 4]) == 16
